text: Fel Exhaust is an ability used by Micronax during a Pet Battle.
The Fel Covenant is an emissary force sent by the Burning Legion to the Nightborne in Suramar City.
Fel Heart Bond is an ability from the Vindicaar and can be activated at the Vindicaar Matrix Core.
__NOTOC__ Fel-crazed Magi are eredar located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.

Fel-Powered Purifiers are vigilants located in Elarian Sanctuary in Antorus, the Burning Throne. They serve as part of the Burning Legion's assault force against Eonar the Life-Binder within her sanctuary there, though they are thwarted by adventurers.
Fel-Powered Sentinels are nightborne constructs located at Nyell's Workshop in Suramar.

Feed the Beast is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Hungering Destroyer after draining all of the large anima canisters with Volatile Ejection in Castle Nathria on Normal difficulty or higher.
Fel Ignitor is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fel Flame Fortification is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Fortified Fel Flame.
__NOTOC__ Feeling It is a world event achievement earned by getting a perfect score in the Darkmoon Faire Dance game on the easiest difficulty 10 times.
The Fel Expanse was a planned subzone in Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.
Fel Infused Worm is a fel worm located in Feltotem in Highmountain during The Feltotem Menace.
Feenix is a flying squirrel located in Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Fel Firebolt is an ability used by a Demonology warlock's Wild Imps.
Unlike other cloth items, Felcloth drops from demons instead of humanoids. Felcloth can also be purified to make Mooncloth.

Fel Rock is a now corrupted cave in Teldrassil. This once beautiful cave is located just north of Dolanaar and is infested with many grells. It is also home to the vicious satyr Lord Melenas. The night elf druid Tallonkai Swiftroot sends alliance players into this foreboding cave to destroy Lord Melenas during the quest Twisted Hatred.

__NOTOC__ Felendren is a Wretched banished from blood elf lands for failing to heed the warnings of their teachers and elders. He is the worst of their society, as he lives only to feed his insatiable magical addictions. Because Felendren refused to learn control, he is but a shell of his former self - one of the Wretched. He now resides atop Falthrien Academy to the southwest of Sunstrider Isle having arcane elementals as minions and sinking deeper and deeper into madness. Magister Duskwither's Journal recounts that Felendren was one of the first of many to fall to base addiction at the Falthrien Academy, where he was a student.
Felcloth Pants are cloth pants made by tailors. They increase spell power, and so are of interest to casters primarily.

Felboars are helboars found in Shadowmoon Valley. They can go into frenzy, and when they do, they grow, turn red, and deal increased damage. Oronok Torn-heart has managed to domesticate a few to help him farm for tubers.

The Fel Pits are a series of fetid and scalding pools lining the western base of the Hand of Gul'dan in central Shadowmoon Valley. Tainted and enraged earth elementals and fire elementals roam the area. This area is a well known grinding spot for Mote of Fire, and can often be crowded at prime time. Furthermore, classes with pets and melee classes should always pull mobs inside the lava out of it before attacking, even if you have to receive damage from a spell (like Fel Firebolt from fire elementals), for lava deals loads of damage if you stand in it. Lots of fire elementals roam around, in fairly close proximity, but there are also earth elementals that drop motes of earth that are much le

:Did you mean the quest Felblood Fillet, or the quest item Monstrous Felblood Snapper? Felblood Snapper is a fish that is caught from the green lava in Shadowmoon Valley or the Pools of Aggonar in Hellfire Peninsula.
Fel Spirits appear after Shattered Hand Berserkers are killed, so long as near an Anchorite Relic while in Hellfire Peninsula.

A Fel Whip drops from Braxxus, Galvanoth, Zarcsin, or the Mo'arg Incinerator. A random one of these demons can be summoned by placing into a Fel Crystal Prism at Forge Camp: Wrath or Forge Camp: Terror in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Felfire Diemetradons are diemetradons found in Shadowmoon Valley.

Felblood Initiates were once the most loyal servants of Kael'thas, according to Magistrix Seyla. When Kael's forces retreated through the portal at the Throne of Kil'jaeden, these elves stayed behind, consuming demon blood for several days, transforming them into felblood elves. They now remain there, draining the energy of Suspended Terrorguards. Magistrix Seyla of the Shattered Sun Offensive charges adventurers with the task of slaying them, during the process of which they transform into Emaciated Felblood‎s.
The Fel Reaver Energy Matrix is located in Legion Hold in Shadowmoon Valley.
Fel Reaver Sentinels can be found at the western and eastern ends of Invasion Point: Cataclysm in Shadowmoon Valley. They can be controlled through Fel Reaver Control Consoles.
Felbolt is the basic ability of the Fel Imp, a warlock minion.

Fel lords are a type of large and powerful mo'arg demons in service of the Burning Legion. Towering over their lesser minions, they often wield massive, yet slow weapons. Speculated by some scholars of the Legion to be an evolved version of the common felguard, fel lords serve as enforcers in the direct service of Archimonde. Their cruelty is matched only by their brute force.
Fel Power dropped from Fel Lord Caza in the Cryptic Hollow on Mardum during the beta. Its ID was reused by Floki's Rune.
Felbane Camp is an Illidari camp found in western Highmountain on the Rockaway Coast.
Felblade Devastators are felguard that appears at the Legion Invasion locations and the Broken Shore.

The Felborne are a group of nightborne who have fully embraced the fel energies of the Burning Legion, turning their eyes green and their skin lighter with a green taint. Nightfallen can also be turned into Felborne, which cures them but makes them hunger for souls. Even after the Legion's defeat in Suramar, the Felborne continue to serve the demons and can be found on the Broken Shore. Felborne are based in the Court of Stars and the southern part of the Crimson Thicket. Several units were also seen aboard Kil'jaeden's command ship in the Twisting Nether. The most common way to become a felborne is to let a doomguard exhale fel on his target.
Fel spreaders (or fel corrupters) are a type of flying construct summoned by the Burning Legion to scorch the ground with fel energy, corrupting everything they touch.

Fel Ravagers are felhound creeps that can be encountered in the Felwood, Outland and Black Citadel tilesets. Fel Ravagers were also summoned by Destroyer Zardikar during the gladiatorial battles in Outland Arena.
__NOTOC__ Felborne Collaborators are felborne located in Suramar City and Felborne Outpost in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Felborne Magi are felborne located in Suramar City and Felborne Outpost in Suramar and on the Broken Shore.
Fel Secretion are oozelings located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.
Felfang Basilisk are basilisks located in the Shattered Chasm in Antoran Wastes.
__NOTOC__ Fel Piston Stabilizer drops from the following satyrs in Shadowmoon Valley: *Shadowhoof Summoner *Shadowhoof Assassin
Felbound Deathguards are fel lords located in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Felbound Enforcers are eredar located in the Court of Stars.
__NOTOC__ Felbound Magi are eredar located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
Felcorrupted Alphas are fel wolves located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
Fel Mortars are devastators / mortars located in Val'sharah during the Legion Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Felbound Desecrators are eredar located in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Felbound Chaos Magi are eredar located in Highmountain attacking Thunder Totem during the Legion Assaults.
Felbound Pyromagi are man'ari eredar located on the Broken Shore and in Highmountain during the Legion Assaults.
The Fel Reaver Ruins is one of the resource nodes of the Eye of the Storm battleground. As the name implies, it is the remains of a destroyed fel reaver.
The Felbound Drudge's Sorrow is a quest reward from Overwhelming Power (quest).
Fel Tree Branches are located at the Moonlight Ascent on the Broken Shore. One of them has a Rappel Point attached, to allow entrance into the caves below.
Felborn Torch is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Felborn Pendant is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Felblade Destroyers are felguard attacking the Peak of Serenity in Kun-Lai Summit during Before the Storm (quest).
Fel Scorched Contract is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Felfire Diemetradon Eyes would likely have dropped from Felfire Diemetradons in Shadowmoon Valley.

Felguard (or Fel Guard and sometimes pluralized as felguards) are demons of the mo'arg race that serve as the Legion's rank and file demonic soldiers and front-line troops. They are fearless and unwaveringly loyal to their master's godlike will. They are almost always seen with heavy, two-handed weaponry. They are slow to strike, but hit quite hard, and are more agile than they look. Felguard are among the demons Sargeras fought against while he was still part of the Pantheon. During the Battle for the Broken Shore which marked the beginning of the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth, felguard units managed to injure both leaders of the Alliance and the Horde, High King Varian Wrynn a

Felo'melorn, Flamestrike in Common, is an ancient Highborne runeblade borne into battle by the Sunstrider dynasty. It was once wielded by Dath'Remar Sunstrider, even before the War of the Ancients. This powerful and storied runeblade, passed down through the Sunstriders for generations, is a mighty weapon said to harness the very essence of flame. Felo'melorn is one of the artifacts used by fire mages in World of Warcraft: Legion. Equipping it will automatically place Heart of the Phoenix in your off hand.
Feline Grace is a passive level 40 druid ability that reduced fall damage while in Cat Form.

__NOTOC__ Felika is a wandering orcish trade goods vendor located in the Drag or the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. After the betrayal of Varimathras and Putress, Sylvanas and Forsaken refugees had to escape to Orgrimmar. During that time Orgrimmar was under martial law and Felika was complaining about the situation along with other citizens.
Feline Mantle is a cloth shoulder pad that provides good caster ability bonuses.
, leader of the Felskorn.]] The Felsworn are mortals who have sworn fealty to the Burning Legion. In return, they were gifted with fel power.
Felmist occurs in Shadowmoon Valley. It can be harvested by engineers using a Zapthrottle Mote Extractor, turning into varying amounts of Mote of Shadow.

Felscale Breastplate is a mail chest piece created by Dragonscale Leatherworking which provides bonuses for critical strike and stamina as well as increased attack power. Good for marksman Hunter. Pattern is taught by Master Leatherworking Trainer.
Felguard Destroyers are felguard located in Hellfire Peninsula.

Felguard elites have proven themselves in combat, and are given additional power and authority by the Burning Legion; they serve as sergeants and squad leaders. Much larger than normal felguard, the elites stand out among their kin. They carry a particularly nasty type of halberd they refer to as a "netheraxe" (a large unholy halberd); this weapon is both a symbol of rank and a useful tool against the virtuous. Felguard elite are about fourteen feet tall and weigh roughly 2,600 pounds. Felguard elite fight like their lesser counterparts, but are better at both giving and following orders.
Felspine's Hide drops from Felspine the Greater in Shadowmoon Valley.
Felsteel Chest is a chest found only in Outland, in varies locations within Shadowmoon Valley, Netherstorm, and Nagrand
Felhound Manastalker are felhounds located in the Blood Furnace. They are summoned by the Shadowmoon Summoner.
__NOTOC__ The Feline Familiar can be purchased during the Hallow's End holiday event. When the player takes flight, this pet flies with them on its own small broom.
Felonius Stark is the innkeeper for the Horde outpost of Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
A Felled Totem is an Enchanting skill-up item. Repairing it will yield either a Sanded Totem or an Magically Banded Totem.
Felguard Oppressors are felguard found in the city of Suramar.
Felsworn Covenant drops from Talixae Flamewreath in Court of Stars.
Felstone Pendant is looted from one of the Moonfang Chests in Val'sharah.

The Felhide Gargantuan is a felstalker located at various places throughout the following zones: *Val'sharah *Highmountain *Stormheim *Azsuna Though it drops no loot, it can be skinned to obtain Felhide.
Felsurge Defenders are naga located at the Felrage Strand on the Broken Shore. They were originally Deepsurge Defenders, empowered with fel by Harrowing Corruptors.
Felsurge Tidesingers are naga located at the Felrage Strand on the Broken Shore. They were originally Deepsurge Tidesingers, empowered with fel by Harrowing Corruptors.
Felspiders are fire spiders found in Azsuna and Highmountain.
Felspawn Imps are imps that briefly appeared in Stormwind's keep. Then they reappeared in Antoran Wastes.
Felforged Sentinel was a fel golem located on the Broken Shore. He was destroyed when the Conclave were searching scattered for Lumenstone weapons.
Felstalker's Ring is a reward from One Who's Worthy (Highmountain).
Felforged Cudgel drops from mobs in the Throne of Kil'jaeden during the Assault on the Throne of Kil'jaeden. They are used to destroy Crystallized Fel Essences.
__NOTOC__ Felsorrow Conquerors are eredar located at the Stormrage Barrow Dens in Moonglade and on the Broken Shore.
Felsorrow Portal-Keepers are eredar located in the Stormrage Barrow Dens in Moonglade.

__NOTOC__ Felsorrow Corruptors are man'ari eredar located on the Broken Shore where they are accompanied by voidwalkers. They also appear at the Stormrage Barrow Dens in Moonglade where they are attempting to corrupt the Wild God Goldrinn.
Felforge Salvagers are wyrmtongues located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.
Felsen Wingclip is an aranakk flight master located at the Renounced Bastille in Maldraxxus.
Feline Adept is a passive level 19 Feral druid ability. It enables the use of Remove Corruption and Soothe in Cat Form.
Feline Femur is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Felguard Destroyer's Legplates drops in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.

Fenris Isle is a large island located in the center of Lordamere Lake and it is generally considered to be a part of Silverpine Forest. Together with the Dawning Isles, they form a broken circle of dry land in the lake.

__NOTOC__ Fenwick Thatros is an undead found near the Decrepit Fields in Silverpine Forest. Varimathras believes Fenwick is the leader of the undead that have taken root in Silverpine Forest, although he proves to be just an underling to Thule Ravenclaw. Ever since Thule Ravenclaw was removed from power, Fenwick appears to have separated himself from Thule and now tries to fish in peace and quiet. He stands next to Killian Sanatha, who does nothing to help him.
Fenstad's Hunch is a delivery quest in Undercity. It is only available during the Love is in the Air holiday.
Fenstad Argyle is a Forsaken quest giver located outside the bank in the Undercity during the annual Love is in the Air event.
Feral Instinct is a passive Feral druid ability. It reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling in Cat Form.
__NOTOC__ Feranin is a blood elf bread and drink vendor located at Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.
The Feralfen tribe is one of three Lost One tribes in Zangarmarsh, and the most powerful of them. They are led by Elder Kuruti.

Ferithos is a drakonid reagent vendor located at the Wyrmrest Temple in the contested territory of Dragonblight, located in the frozen wastes of Northrend. He is one of few known green drakonid, meaning he serves Ysera as a member of the green dragonflight. During Deathwing's final assault on the Temple, Ferithos was injured but soon healed by a Crimson Lifebinder.

Feral Spirit is an Enhancement shaman ability that summons two Spirit Wolf pets. They can act independently (e.g. attack two different targets), though any commands issued by the shaman direct both wolves. When the wolves deal damage, their Spirit Hunt effect heals the shaman. They last for 15 seconds or until killed.

The Feral Defender is an add that spawns during the Auriaya encounter in the Ulduar raid instance. The Feral Defender has the following statistics and abilities: *200,000 HP (10 man)/600,000 HP (25 man) *Spawns about 1 minute into the fight and emerges from [http://www.wowhead.com/?spell=64459 Seeping Feral Essence] about thirty seconds after the death of a previous Feral Defender. *The Feral Defender is tauntable, but not tankable. It will randomly aggro and jump from one target to the next. * [http://www.wowhead.com/?spell=64455 Feral Essence] - Each essence increases the damage dealt by the Feral Defender by 50%. The Feral Defender can revive himself at the cost of one of his Feral Essenc

Feralas is a level 15 - 30 zone in southwestern Kalimdor for both the Horde and Alliance. It follows pretty much the same story for both sides, with the Alliance starting at Dreamer's Rest and the Horde going to Camp Ataya. From there, they go to Feathermoon Stronghold and Stonemaul Hold, respectively. For the Horde, they go to their last hub in the zone, Camp Mojache, while the Alliance stops at The Tower of Estulan before meeting up with Adella in Shadebough. The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Feralas Quests.
Feras is a rare cheetah located just to the east of Malaka'Jin in Stonetalon Mountains.
Ferocious Necklace of the Golden Lotus is a quest reward from The Final Power.

Fen-Yu, Fury of Xuen is one of Wrathion's legendary cloak quest rewards for completing A Pandaren Legend in patch 5.4. It is the upgraded version of Tigerfang Wrap, created by using the Timeless Essence of the Black Dragonflight. Using the timeless essence will automatically upgrade the cloak to item level 136.
Fene-mal is a rare ghostly vulture that can be found flying above the ruined buildings just to the east of Blackwood Lake in Eastern Plaguelands.
Fennimore Quigley is credited with milking the first camel and breaking the record for "longest unintentional flight," all in the same afternoon.
The Felwing Doombringer can be found in the city of Suramar.
Feral Affinity is a level 30 talent that allows non-Feral druids access to certain abilities that would otherwise be unavailable to them.

__NOTOC__ Feltongue Corruptors are eredar that appeared at the Legion Invasion locations. They were usually found powering a Protected Fel Crystal nearby. They accompanied the Legion forces when they invaded Karazhan in Deadwind Pass.
Feral Power is a Feral druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Hardened Roots and Protection of Ashamane traits.
__NOTOC__ Felsworn Nobles are felborne located in Suramar City.
__NOTOC__ Felsworn Overseers are felborne located in Suramar City.
Felwing Ledge is a breeding ground for felbats. It is part of Mardum and is located just northeast of its main continent. It is only accessible during the quest To Fel and Back (quest).
Feltotem Spiritwalkers are Highmountain tauren located on the Broken Shore.
Ferocious Gladiator's Storm Dragon is a Feat of Strength for acquiring a Ferocious Gladiator's Storm Dragon mount from Legion Season 4.
Feltotem Necromancers are Highmountain tauren located on the Broken Shore.
Female Human Captives are humans located in the War Quarter of the Undercity. They are summoned by Lysta Bancroft to face Edward and Tyler. Only one is summoned at a time.
The Femur of Improbability is found at Deadgrin in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Felweaver Pharamere is an eredar located at the Shattered Walkway in the Nighthold.
Feltotem Bonehounds are skeletal fel hounds located in Highmountain.
Feltotem Demonkindres are fel beasts located in Highmountain. They are actually Feltotem tauren. When the beasts are killed, they revert to their tauren form.
Felwing Screechers are felbats located on the Broken Shore, Dalaran and in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Felwing Terrors are felbats located in Old Coast Path and Farondale in Azsuna and around Thunder Totem in Highmountain during Legion Assaults.

__NOTOC__ Fernwood Ridge is a forested area west of Algerson Lumber Yard in northern Tiragarde Sound. The ridge is home to a large colony of Mossfang spiders, as well as a population of Ashclaw bears. As the nearby lumber yard expanded, the ridge's wildlife was magically enthralled by a mysterious figure known as the Witch of the Woods, who began using them to attack the lumberjacks. Under the witch's influence, the spiders and bears of Fernwood began to run rampant. Adventurers of the Alliance aiding Maynard Algerson were eventually sent to deal with the threat, reducing the beasts' numbers and slaying the Mossfang Matriarch. Ultimately, the Witch of the Woods herself was defeated, ending t
Feral Dreamers are wolves located in the Emerald Dream version of Gilneas City during A Gilnean's Dream. They disappear once Tess Greymane's vision starts.
Feralclaw the Rager is a wendigo located in Island Expedition.
Feral Protectors are night elf druids located in Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ :Successful raiders never leave home without it. Field Repair Bot 74A is an Engineer-created robot that can be deployed anywhere. The item is consumed upon use. It essentially functions as a merchant with a repair ability: it can both completely repair gear and purchase items from players. It also sells minor Engineering components. It lasts for 10 minutes and there is a 10 minute cooldown on the robot so you can only deploy one at a time. It was considered to be one of the most important engineering items in the game, especially useful for repairing entire raid groups without having to leave a dungeon.
__NOTOC__ Fey Dragons are faerie dragons found in Stonetalon Mountains.
Feth's Way is the easternmost path running through the Ruins of Silvermoon in Eversong Woods.
The Festive Green Dress is sold by Valadar Starsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade for during the Lunar Festival.
The Festive Purple Dress is sold by Valadar Starsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade for during the Lunar Festival.
Festival Dumplings are sold in stacks of 8 by Valadar Starsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade for during the Lunar Festival.
The Field Testing Kit can be purchased for from in the Undercity. Since patch 4.0.1, it has no use as the quests involving this item have been removed.
Fey Dragon Scales dropped from the following faerie dragons in Stonetalon Mountains: * Nal'taszar * Wily Fey Dragon * Fey Dragon

__NOTOC__ Field Repair Bot 110G is an upgraded version of Field Repair Bot 74A - Engineer-created robot that can be deployed anywhere. It essentially functions as a merchant with a repair ability: it can both completely repair gear and purchase items from players. It also sells common reagents and minor Engineering components. It lasts for 10 minutes and there is a 10 minute cooldown on the robot so you can only create one at a time. Item is created with 5 charges. It is considered to be one of the most important engineering items in the game, especially useful for repairing entire raid groups without having to leave a dungeon.

The Festival of the Lake is held twice a year, at midsummer and midwinter, by the people of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. In the summer, people fish and swim, while in the winter they ice fish and skate. Like all good festivals, they serve a fine ale during these times. In the winter, they serve hot wine, which the high elves and half-elves seem to like.

Fezhar was an orc warrior who fought alongside Broxigar to hold a mountain pass against the Burning Legion during the Battle of Mount Hyjal. His body was dissolved when a demon belched fel fire on him.
Fezzix Geartwist is a goblin located at Taunka'le Village in the Borean Tundra. He is trying to fix a gnomish flying machine from the crashed remains of a plane from Fizzcrank Airstrip.

Fiendish creatures are extraplanar creatures (typically an outsider, elemental, or magical beast native to another plane) with different alignments that can be summoned using various Summon Monster spells. This is in contrast to the various Summon Nature's Ally spells which summon natural creatures who are all of a neutral alignment. Warlocks can summon fiendish creatures.
Festering Strike is a Unholy death knight ability that applies Festering Wound.

__NOTOC__ The Festival Lantern is sold by Valadar Starsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade for during the Lunar Festival. While this companion can only be seen and bought by Horde players, it is not soulbound and can be put in the auction house.

.]] .]] The Fields of Niuzao comprise the remainder of the island just off the western coast of the mainland of Townlong Steppes not occupied by the Niuzao Temple or the Sra'thik Incursion. A large part of the fields is northwest of the temple and southwest of the great tree, populated by friendly Wild Townlong Yaks and hostile Osul Farstalkers. Bluesaddle and Cousin Bag-of-Rocks relocate to just south of the pond after Bad Yak. The path to the Niuzao Catacombs is just southwest of the pond and Bluesaddle, marked by a couple of banners. Just north of that is the broken bridge to Sra'vess. When the fish of the day is Redbelly Mandarin, the lake will be full to bursting of pools of fish, and S

__NOTOC__ Fey-Drunk Darter are Faerie dragons that can be found in the Whispering Forest of the Tirisfal Glades. Near the center of the Whispering Forest is a ring of giant mushrooms. Every now and again, the Fey-Drunk Darters begin to appear, one by one, and fly erratically in the general area of the mushroom ring. Over time seven of them will fade in, and at some point all seven darters seem to come to some forgone conclusion and they converge on the ring. The Fey-Drunk Darters begin to sing. As they sing, beams of light shine from each darter, converging on the center of the mushroom ring. The other animals of the glen come to watch, curious about the lights and sounds no doubt, and just
Fetid Bloodworms are bloodworms located in Ihgaluk Crag on the Isle of Thunder. They are spawned from damaging or destroying a Fetid Meat Pile.
Fevermelt Legguards drop from Talixae Flamewreath in the Court of Stars.

The Fields of An'she are a bear-infested field of flowers located in western Highmountain, north of Trueshot Lodge, northwest of Pinerock Basin, and south of the Witchwood. The area contains the western entrance to the Mucksnout Den. The area contains a small Rivermane settlement.

Fhambar is a felstalker called by Ritssyn Flamescowl in the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran to accompany the Archdruid of the Dreamgrove to track down Levia Laurence through Soul Engine: Apocalypse to the Den of Fiends in Azsuna, after which Ritssyn teleported him back to his side.
Festering Assistants are gnomes found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
__NOTOC__ Fevered Explorers are sick individuals located in Highmountain, Azsuna, Stormheim, and Val'sharah. Some of them are humans of Gilneas.

Fesa Spelldriver is a goblin located at Vengeance Landing in the Howling Fjord, next to Drenk Spannerspark. Since The Cloudkisser is out of commission, she created a mage portal to Undercity to compensate.
Ferocity of the Cenarion Circle is a Feral druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Thrashing Claws (artifact trait) trait.
Ferocity of the Silver Hand is a Retribution paladin artifact trait.

Field Marshal Cogspark is a gnome located at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City during the War of the Thorns. She holds the portal to Astranaar open during A Disturbance in Ashenvale. She also participated in the Battle for Lordaeron.
Ferocity of the Broken Temple is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Split Personality (monk artifact trait) trait.
__NOTOC__ Fervent Warscryers are blood elves located in Nazmir during the Faction Assaults. They are using blood magic on blood orbs.
Fevered Incantation is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Fevered Incantation.
Fetid Muckbinders are gnolls located at the Fetid Encampment in Thaldraszus. They can be found empowering the Mucklings in the mud pools.
Field Scout's Bindings are a quest reward from Black Wagon Flight.
Field Commander Ignax leads the black dragonflight forces fighting in the Battlefield Ruins of northern Zaralek Cavern from the Obsidian Spire Outpost.
__NOTOC__ Fiery Core is the internal core of a very powerful, flame-based elemental. Used in numerous high-level craftable items often paired with Lava Cores. It is also required to smelt Elementium.

Filson the Rat is an unusual rat found in the zoo in the upper left corner of on the Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos human campaign chapter 6, The Culling and is located at the Stratholme Zoo. He has the remarkable ability to evade any attack made against him. A crafty player will figure out a way to kill him by either clicking him multiple times, causing him to explode (as Warcraft III all critters do when repeatedly clicked), or by employing a Mortar Team (or a Cannon Tower if the player is in the mood for overkill). Although Filson will evade the initial projectile from the attack, the splash damage will kill him. Fittingly, he drops a Talisman of Evasion. In Warcraft III: Reforged, Filson i
Find Ranshalla is the 2nd quest in the Moontouched Wildkin quest chain.

Figurines are special animal-shaped trinkets crafted by Jewelcrafters. Figurines must be equipped in one of the trinket slots to get their effects as well as make them usable. When the figurine is used, it summons a magical creature that will aid you in some way. Each figurine is unique.
Figurine - Black Diamond Crab is a Level 55 quality Jewelcrafting Trinket that improves Dodge rating. It has an on-use ability that temporarily reduces melee damage taken.
Figurine - Dark Iron Scorpid is a Level 55 quality Trinket that improves Agility. It has an on-use ability that causes your melee swing to poison it's target.

Find Treasure was a dwarf racial trait that tracked chests and other items on the minimap. While it was active, chests, food crates, and some quest items were revealed as a gold dot () on the minimap. If you were on a quest that required gathering specific items scattered around, this skill would track them. For example, the quest In Case of Emergency... asks you to collect 30 pieces of Zeppelin Debris. With Find Treasure on you would be able to see them on your minimap. (Unfortunately, this ability did not seem to reveal anything in Northrend other than chests.)
The Filled Flasket is obtained when using the Hardened Flasket at the Jadefire Satyrs' corrupted moonwell in Felwood.
Fiery Beholder Eye drops from Collidus the Warp-Watcher in Shadowmoon Valley.
Filled Crystal Phial is create by filling a Crystal Phial at the moonwell in Shadowglen for Tenaron Stormgrip.
Create this item by filling a at the moonwell in Starbreeze Village.
Create a Filled Tourmaline Phial by filling a at the moonwell near the Pools of Arlithrien.
Create this item by filling a at the moonwell in Oracle Glade.

Filler may refer to a class-ability or spell which has a rather bland effect. Is implemented simply to ensure that players always have a ready (not on cooldown) button to click, or to equalize the number of spells divided on the various classes.

Find Fish is a starting ability for the Fishing profession that helps by displaying nearby fishing pool on the mini-map as a gold fish (). It can be learned by acquiring the Weather-Beaten Journal from a Curious Crate or other container, sometimes found in Floating Wreckage.
__NOTOC__ The Fight Promoter is a goblin that acts as an Innkeeper and allows players to teleport to their allied capital cities on the Arena Tournament realms.
Filled Cleansing Bowl is created by using Empty Cleansing Bowl at the moonwell in Auberdine in Darkshore.
The Fifth Company was part of the forces defending Stormwind City during the First War.

Filling Up The Barn is a collection achievement earned for learning how to summon 25 mounts on a single character. Using an enchantment such as the one from Fresh Holly to change your mount will not count towards this achievement. Temporary items you can use like mounts (such as Flying Broom) do not count towards this achievement.
Fiery Familiar Stone is created with the ability Conjure Familiar. Using it summons a Fiery Familiar as a guardian.

Fight for the Alliance is a Feats of Strength achievement rewarded for logging in to an Alliance character following the international premiere of the Warcraft movie on May 24, 2016. It is obtainable beginning May 25, 2016 and lasts through August 1, 2016. The former date may have been a typo, as players reported receiving it on May 24, 2016 instead.

Fight for the Horde is a Feats of Strength achievement rewarded for logging in to a Horde character following the international premiere of the Warcraft movie on May 24, 2016. It is obtainable beginning May 25, 2016 and lasts through August 1, 2016. The former date may have been a typo, as players reported receiving it on May 24, 2016 instead.
Fierce Gladiator's Storm Dragon is an achievement reward from Gladiator: Legion Season 5. Obtaining this mount also awards the Feat of Strength Fierce Gladiator's Storm Dragon (achievement).
Fierce Hatchlings are rocs that spawn during the encounter with Ala'washte at Ala'washte's Nest in Highmountain.
The Fight Club Treasure Chest is a chest located in the Bloody Grotto on Mechagon Island. It is put up, by Bookie Longshot, every 30 minutes, starting at the top of the hour.
Fierce Fliers is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the corrupted pets of Argus with all Flying pets.
Fiery Leystone Deposit is a mining vein found south of Torok's Bluff in Highmountain.
Fight or Flight is an Azerite trait available to all classes. It can only be found on Azerite Armor from PvP sources, such as War Supply Chests.
Fierce Razorwing is a razorwing flying mount rarely found inside the Death's Advance Supplies paragon reward for the Death's Advance faction on Korthia.
__NOTOC__ Fierce Combatant is a feat of strength achievement earned by winning 100 Arena (3v3) or 40 Rated Battlegrounds in Legion Season 5.
The Filled Unholy Gem is obtained by draining the powers of Duke Vallenhal at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight with an Unholy Gem.
Final Sentence is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Final Sentence.
Fiery Soul is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Soul of Fire.
Fightlord San is a Maldraxxi gladiator located in the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus. He was approached by the Maw Walker and Salandria who asked him to empower a sin'dorei ranseur.

Fifth Challenge of Tyr: Ingenuity begins the fifth and final portion of the "The Spark of Ingenuity" quest line, awarding another Bottled Essence and the ability to acquire more from adventures out in the world. This quest was originally unlocked the week of 2023-01-24.
Fiery Leystone Ore is mined from Fiery Leystone Deposits south of Torok's Bluff in Highmountain.

A finishing move is a type of rogue or cat form druid skill that requires combo points on the target before it can be performed. The effect of the finishing move is more powerful or lasts longer if more combo points are gained prior to use. Successfully using the move resets the combo points on that target back to zero.

Fire Scar Shrine is located in southwestern Ashenvale, southwest of Astranaar, south of the Shrine of Aessina, and west of the Ruins of Stardust. It has been corrupted by the demonic influence of the Shadow Council, and is now a place of great evil. A powerful orcish warlock, Ilkrud Magthrull, previously resided at the shrine in service to the leader of the Cult of the Dark Strand, Athrikus Narassin. The Shrine is now infested by demons which the Adventurer is tasked with culling by Bolyun. A rare doomguard named Akkrilus will appear in the shrine's area occasionally.

__NOTOC__ Fire Beetles are critters found in Mount Hyjal, the Searing Gorge, the Blasted Lands, Un'Goro Crater and Burning Steppes. They require the high temperature and humidity to survive. They are also inexplicably found in the fiery corridors of Shattered Halls in the Hellfire Citadel.
Fire Hardened Leggings are Warrior mail leggings that give a bonus to strength and stamina.
Fire Elemental Totem is a Shaman totem ability that summons a fire elemental to aid the caster.
Fire Breath is an active pet ability used by Dragonhawks. It was called Dragonhawk Fire during the beta.
Fire Bombs are only usable from fixed flight path wyverns around Halaa in Nagrand.

Fire-Toasted Buns are a quest reward of these Midsummer Fire Festival quests: *Flickering Flames in the Eastern Kingdoms *Flickering Flames in Kalimdor *Stealing Darnassus's Flame *Stealing the Undercity's Flame

A fire golem (aka golem of fire) was a creature created through the power of the Demon Soul. It was a humanoid figure with a flaming bone shape and burning skull for a head. Armor appeared as flaming bones covering the monstrous warrior. Their hellish flames give off no physical heat, but if touched, pain such as even a seasoned fighter could not imagine would be caused. Only the holder of the Demon Soul could order the fire golems. Even Zuluhed the Whacked was at risk of getting killed if Nekros Skullcrusher wasn't there to order the golem to let his chieftain pass into Alexstrasza's chamber.

Firebeard Cemetery is located very close to Firebeard's Patrol, in the Devouring Breach of the Twilight Highlands. In its cathedral is where the fallen heroes of the Firebeard clan are buried. Iain Firebeard bore the body of one of the fallen here and was commanded by Keegan Firebeard to reform a wing of gryphon riders from whatever scattered forces he could find. With the help of an adventurer Iain managed to do so, including getting some recently made weapons from Brom Forgehammer. The cathedral was probably destroyed when the Twilight's Hammer created the Devouring Breach.
Fineas G. Bankworthy is a human banker in the Royal Bank of Stormwind of the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. He can be found standing in the center of the guild vault room.
__NOTOC__ Finlay Coolshot runs the Tonk Challenge game at the Darkmoon Faire.

Fire Spirit is a rare item that when used granted a permanent skill increase to your primary professions. The increase was reported to vary between 3 and 5 points and was granted to each of your currently trained primary professions. After using it, a red wisp would fly away.
Fire Quills is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

__NOTOC__ Fine Poking Stick was sold by Griftah after he was banished in patch 2.2.0, just outside Shattrath's southeastern tunnel in Terokkar Forest. However, Griftah made his triumphal return to the city proper in patch 2.3.0... minus his stock of poking sticks.

Finely-Tailored Red Holiday Hat can drop from the following during Winter Veil: *Raids **Fetid Devourer in Uldir **Krosus in The Nighthold *Dungeons **Vol'kaal in Atal'Dazar **Skycap'n Kragg in Freehold **Talixae Flamewreath in Court of Stars **Saprish in the The Seat of the Triumvirate
The Fire-Imbued Gem is one of four gems used to power the barrier blocking off Xylem's Tower in Azshara.
Finely-Tuned Stormsteel Destroyer is created by using Kul Tiran and Zandalari Engineering.
Finely-Honed Bone Blades is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fire Resistance Bolts is looted from Dredged Canisters on Mechagon Island.
Finger of Frozen Fury is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ Finn is a human child located outside Northshear Abbey in the Trade District of Stormwind City. He sells cosmetic eyeglasses, also sold by his Horde counterpart Ca'nees. Fires of the Seas are braziers located in Durotar. They are used by Zar'jira to empower herself.
Fine-Link Gauntlets are a quest reward from Profitability Scouting.

Fire Breath Infusers are found at the Old Weyrn Grounds just outside the entrance to the War Creche in the Forbidden Reach. Interacting with these devices resets the cooldown of Fire Breath (evoker ability).

Finduin Wryngrrlgulgll is a murloc found in Azmerloth. He is an alternate version of Anduin Wrynn. He is later found all grown up with Ironus Coldsteel at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus, looking for his sword, Seashellamayne. He reappears in Azmerloth during Time Rifts where he provides Power Word: Mrglflurg to adventurers.

.]] First Aid is a secondary profession which enables a player to heal players and to remove poisons, notably through a variety of bandages. Bandages can be made from cloths, with higher quality cloth producing more effective bandages. Bandages can only be applied to a same character once every 60 seconds, until the Recently Bandaged debuff disappears. First Aid practitioners can also make anti-venom consumables from venom sacs dropped by various poisonous monsters (e.g., scorpids and spiders), though they are not as powerful as those created by Alchemists. The Firegut ogres of the Burning Steppes are allies of the Blackrock orcs. They work closely with those orcs, keeping the mineral rich Dreadmaul Rock guarded and the supply lines open at all times. For a short time they were led by Gor'tesh until he was killed. Gorlop leads the clan currently... until he fell into lava. All Firegut ogre mobs have Flamestrike as a racial ability.

The Firelord is a Neutral Hero in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne and was added in August, 2004. Firelords are sentient elementals, more complex and powerful beings than the mindless water elementals Alliance mages call to battle. While being neutral heroes in Warcraft III, they are vicious elites in World of Warcraft, found in the Molten Core. Long ago, when the world was in a state of constant turmoil, the Elementals (Earth, Wind, Fire and Water) faithfully served their Old-God masters. When the Old Gods were defeated by the coming of the Titans, the Elementals were banished to an alternate plane of existence. Over time the world became Azeroth, where Human wizards learned how to call back
Firebolt is the starting ability of the Imp, a warlock minion. It is the Imp's only method of attack. As its name suggests, this spell launches a bolt of fire at the Imp's target.

First Mate Fitzsimmons is a human quest giver located outside Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor in the Alliance-aligned zone of the Wetlands. He was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, a Kul Tiras ship that was destroyed by red dragons during the Second War. He is the sole survivor of the Lost Fleet, and now spends most of his time getting drunk outside the Deepwater Tavern. He also has a tendency of smelling quite bad. He disappears once the Eye of Paleth is retrieved. While he originally was alive, Glorin Steelbrow reveals that he had drunk himself to death the year before the Cataclysm. His spirit still haunts the area, now and then appealing to adventurers to get the Eye. Steelbrow t

Fireflies are glowing, winged insect creatures found in Azeroth, Outland and draenor. Adventurers hunt them for their beautiful diaphanous wings. Commonly used by sporelings as a light source as they navigate the waterways of Zangarmarsh, this luminescent insect helps them avoid the dangerous bogflare needlers. Scholars have debated at length about how fireflies glow, but the leading hypothesis is "magic". They feed on small leaves and grass, but one species is known to consume purple flowers and nectar to retain a deep violet glow. Glowflies use their luminescent to attract mates, while waterflies use the surface of water to reflect the light from their abdomen to attract their mates. On ve

Firewing Point is an outpost maintained by Kael'thas Sunstrider's blood elves in northeastern Terokkar Forest. In the courtyard of this outpost is a mana bomb similar to one found at the nearby Cenarion Thicket and set off by Kael's forces at Kirin'Var Village in what is now Netherstorm. The final code to set off the bomb is held by a Blood Knight named Sharth Voldoun, who resides at the top of the tower high above the courtyard. The Blood Elves at Firewing Point wear Firewing Signets which allies of the Scryers in nearby Shattrath City can collect to enhance their reputation.

This article lists items that are created in the profession First Aid - to be accurate, it actually lists the abilities to create the different items. Most of the respective articles will however just describe the crafted items.
__NOTOC__ Fireguard Destroyers are fire elementals found in Blackrock Depths.
First Fragment of the Cipher of Damnation is contained in Coilskar Chests in Shadowmoon Valley.
Edgar Flores is the first mate of The Assurance which is found at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

Firelands Forgeworks, also known as the Anvil of Flame, is a corridor within the Firelands and only accessible from the flamegate on Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal. It is here Forgemaster Pyrendius crafts weapons for the Twilight's Hammer. It is also here Cindermaul, the portal master, can be found. He holds the secret of constructing portals between realms. The corridor is protected by Searing Guardians and Dark Iron Laborers. Goldrinn has sent many followers into this area, none of which have returned. Among those followers is Jordan Olafson and Yargra Blackscar. They provide quests for the area. Once the forgemaster is taken care of, Jordan will make sure the gateway is destroyed on their

First Home is a jungle on the Darkspear Islands where the sunlight nor a breeze can penetrate the foliage of the dense undergrowth. The air is thick and dense. It is dark at all times, and the only way to know if it is night is from the coolness in the air and the clouds of angry buzzing insects. Many dangerous creatures and plants can be found here such as raptors, kommu, alchu bugs, nambus, upka leaves, and big mosquitoes. It is here the Darkspear loa, ancient spirits of those who had transcended death, can give a troll second sight or drive him mad so that he would pull out his own eyes. The loa, which can grant wondrous boons or inflict terrible punishments, make judgments upon those tha

Firebough Nook was a small pandaren settlement nestled in the shadow of the Serpent's Spine in the southwest corner of Kun-Lai Summit. The Sha of Anger has come through, infesting nearby yaungol under the command of Kobai, leaving behind Blind Rage, and utterly destroying the village. The sha-infested yaungol are also attacking the Shado-Pan Fallback of the Serpent's Spine, which is where Shado-Master Chong is trying to rally a desperate defense of the position, looking for help from the Shado-Pan Monastery which has not been coming.
Fireworks is a hunter ability, learned from Fireworks Instruction Manual.
The Firefury Giant is a magma giant located on the Bleeding Mountain in Frostfire Ridge.
__NOTOC__ Firn Swiftbreeze is a night elf flight master located at Southport in Spires of Arak.
.]] Firefly Tavern is the inn of the Cenarion Refuge, owned by Innkeeper Coryth Stoktron. It can be visited during the Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl. The local specialty is the Coilfang Reserve.

The First Responders was a faction, involved with First Aid quests on the Broken Isles. High in their floating home city of Dalaran, Olisarra and Angelique treat the injured, the sick and the quite nearly, fatally wounded. They also sell wares to travelers who are in need of medical supplies.
Fireblood is an active racial ability for all Dark Iron dwarves that removes harmful effects and increases a primary stat.
Firestorm is an Elemental shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Elementalist (shaman artifact trait) and Surge of Power (shaman artifact trait) traits.

Fires of Justice is a Retribution Paladin talent that reduces the cooldown of Crusader Strike and grants it a chance to cost 1 less holy power. It is an exclusive choice node with Zeal (paladin talent).
__NOTOC__ Firewarden Viton Darkflare is a blood elf located in Shatterfall Pass in Stormsong Valley during the Faction Assaults. He is shooting fireballs at Atwater Stead.
First Mate Topping is a goblin standing next to Dread Captain DeMeza in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Firesting Dominators are ravager wasps located in Island Expeditions. They come in two variants, the red ones are elites while the green one is a rare mob.
The Firekin Belt is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Elemental Salvage.
First Dance is a world event achievement earned by successfully participating in the Darkmoon Faire Dance game.
